description: This file defines an Evented class with methods for event handling, including adding/removing listeners, firing events, and event propagation, as part of the Leaflet library.

classes.name: Evented
classes.description: A class that provides event handling capabilities, including methods for managing event listeners and propagation.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds event listener(s) for specified event type(s).

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes event listener(s) for specified event type(s).

methods.name: _on
methods.description: Internal method to attach a listener for a specific event type.

methods.name: _off
methods.description: Internal method to detach a listener for a specific event type.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event of a given type, optionally propagating it.

methods.name: listens
methods.description: Checks if there are listeners for a specific event type, optionally including parent event handlers.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Adds a one-time event listener that is removed after being invoked.

methods.name: addEventParent
methods.description: Adds an event parent to receive propagated events.

methods.name: removeEventParent
methods.description: Removes an event parent from receiving propagated events.

methods.name: _propagateEvent
methods.description: Internal method to propagate events to parent event handlers.
